Here are simplified definitions for the technical terms in the text:

**Photosynthesis**
This is how plants make their own food. They use sunlight as energy to turn water and carbon dioxide into sugar (food) and release oxygen into the air. It is the main way plants grow and survive.

**Chlorophyll**
This is the green pigment found in plants. You can think of it as the plant’s solar panel. It captures sunlight so the plant can use that energy to make food.

**Glucose**
This is a type of simple sugar. It is the main source of energy for living things. When plants make food through photosynthesis, they produce glucose to fuel their growth and survival.

**Byproduct**
This is something that is produced in addition to the main product. In photosynthesis, oxygen is the byproduct. The plant’s main goal is to make food (glucose), and oxygen is just released as a result.
